facts.summary: Preparing Phase II trial start; no adverse event reported · Phase 1 completed · ONP-002 in concussion · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Oragenics, Inc. (NYSE American: OGEN) ... today announced it is preparing for a Phase II clinical trial using its novel drug - device combination for the treatment of mild Traumatic Brain Injury, aka concussion.
evidence.safety: A 40-patient Phase I study showed ONP-002 to be safe and well-tolerated.
